title: Add a note to a slice in ork

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Closes parity row 1.6 and the "Add a note to a slice" gap (docs/orchestrator-parity.md, section 1; the Prioritized gaps table, gap 6). Today the owner has a decision to record on a slice, runs `slicer note` through an outer session, and ork never writes a note the owner typed. ork calls `slicer note` only for `Review FAIL` (`internal/engine/states.go:567`) and for approval marks (`internal/engine/approval.go:132`).

Owner decision 2026-10-29: this gap is v1.0 (everything except S173, S179 and S180 is).

Facts checked on 2026-10-29:
- `slicer note ID --text TEXT` exists and works on a bare or a promoted item. slicer dates the note itself ("**2026-10-29** - text") and returns `{"id":"S01","added":true}`. Text that starts with `-` is stored as typed. An unknown id gives the tool error `no_such_item`.
- The client call exists: `Client.Note` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:169-172`) runs `slicer note ID --text TEXT --render --json`. Its only callers pass a worktree as root. This slice calls it with the project root.
- `slicer show ID --json --lean` already returns the notes, and `internal/slicercli/types.go` decodes them into the `Notes` field of `Item`.
- No code in `internal/` outside tests reads that field, so the item pane of the Roadmap never shows a note (it draws the title, size and spec sections only, `internal/tui/roadmap.go:112-141`).
- slicer has its own note editor in `slicer tui` (slicer S63, done). ork does not copy that editor. It adds the one thing the owner needs here: type a line, see it recorded, without leaving ork.
- Boundary: ork never opens, parses or edits tracking files (`AGENTS.md`, Tracking). Every read and write goes through the slicer CLI. slicer owns the note; ork keeps no copy.

Decided records that apply: `scope.v1-ork-edits` (#173, include) moves filing a slice (S170), adding notes (S171), and answering or asking adj records (S172, S185) into v1.0. Reordering or parking (S67-S69), the matrix editor (S173), and spec drafting (S179) stay later. `ui.slicer-tui` (#11) says common edits live in ork.

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it):
- `ork note PROJECT ITEM TEXT [--json]`. TEXT of `-` reads stdin. Prints `noted ITEM`. JSON: `{"item":"S12","noted":true}`.
- Daemon method `item.note` (params `{project,item,text}`, result `{item}`). The daemon runs the slicer call, then reads the project's items again so the notes in the snapshot are current.
- Roadmap key `N` (shift-n): a one-line field for a note on the row under the cursor, or on the item that the open item pane shows. `enter` sends, `esc` cancels. A blank note is refused before any call.
- The item pane lists the item's notes under a `Notes (N)` heading, so the owner sees the note that was just added.

Not in this slice: editing or removing a note (slicer has no remove command; `slicer tui` does that), note kinds and `--owner`, multi-line notes in the TUI, a note on a run (the run pane), and any use of notes to file slices (that is S170, which runs after this slice).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestNoteRefusesEmptyText` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`): `Client.Note` with blank text returns an error and makes no slicer call.
- `TestItemNoteWritesTheNoteAndReadsItemsAgain` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): `item.note` on a registered project runs `slicer note ID --text T --render --json --root PROJECT`, then refreshes the Items part, so the next snapshot lists the note.
- `TestItemNoteRefusals` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): blank text and blank item give `bad_params`, an unknown project gives `not_found`, an unknown field gives `bad_params`, and none of them calls slicer.
- `TestItemNoteKeepsTheSlicerErrorCode` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): a `no_such_item` from slicer reaches the caller with that code.
- `TestNoteCommandAddsANote` (`internal/cli/note_test.go`): `ork note P S12 "text"` calls `item.note` and prints `noted S12`; with `--json` it prints `{"item":"S12","noted":true}`.
- `TestNoteCommandReadsStdinForDash` (`internal/cli/note_test.go`): TEXT `-` sends the stdin text, trimmed of its trailing newline.
- `TestNoteCommandUsage` (`internal/cli/note_test.go`): wrong argument counts and a blank note exit 2 before the daemon is dialed.
- `TestRoadmapNoteKeyOpensTheFieldAndSends` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): `N` on a Roadmap row opens "Note for S90:", typed text and `enter` call the writer once with project, item and text, then the status says `Noted S90` and the project is fetched again.
- `TestRoadmapNoteFieldOwnsItsKeys` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): while the field is open, `+`, `-`, `q`, `l` and digits are typed into it (`projectTextEntry` is true), and `esc` closes it with no write.
- `TestRoadmapNoteRefusals` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): no daemon, an unavailable project, the Running entry, an open help overlay and a blank note each refuse with the status text and no write.
- `TestItemPaneListsNotes` (`internal/tui/roadmap_test.go`): the item pane shows `Notes (2)` and both notes after the sections; an item without notes shows no heading.
- `TestNoteFromTheItemPaneReloadsTheDetail` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): `N` inside the item pane notes that item and reads `item.show` again, so the new note appears in the pane.
- `TestHintBarOffersNoteOnTheRoadmap` (`internal/tui/hint_test.go`): the Roadmap hint line lists `N note` only when a daemon is connected and a project is selected.
- `TestGoldenRoadmapNote` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): the open field at 100x30, colour and mono.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). It touches `internal/tui`, `docs/dashboard.md` and `internal/cli` output. Run tests first for each step; write the failing tests above before the code.

1. `internal/slicercli/write.go:168-172`: make `Client.Note` return an error for blank item or text, as `EditAppend` does (`write.go:240-242`). Keep the argv `note ID --text TEXT --render --json` (`TestNoteWritesTheReviewFailText`, `write_test.go:201`, pins it).
2. `internal/daemon/wire.go:17-33`: add `MethodItemNote = "item.note"` (*proposed*). After `ItemShowResult` (`wire.go:295-298`) add `ItemNoteParams{Project, Item, Text string}` and `ItemNoteResult{Item string}`.
3. `internal/daemon/items.go`: add `itemNote(ctx, p)`. Order: reject blank item or text with `badParams` (as `itemShow`, `items.go:12-14`); `d.registered(p.Project)` (`reads.go:77`); `d.runDeps(proj).Slicer.Note(ctx, runrec.Writer{}, proj.Path, p.Item, text)` (`runDeps`, `runs.go:159`). A bare `runrec.Writer` has no Sink, as in `RecordSpecAnswers` (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:373`): a note outside a run has no run record to log into. Then `d.cache.Refresh(ctx, proj, source.Items)` (as `refresh`, `handlers.go:568-578`). Return slicer's error unchanged so its code survives (`ipc.ErrorOf`). Add the case at `handlers.go:121-126`.
4. `internal/daemon/client.go:213-219`: add `ItemNote(ctx, project, item, text) error`.
5. `internal/cli/note.go` (new, SPDX line first): `ork note PROJECT ITEM TEXT`, note-local flag parsing that treats TEXT after ITEM as literal (including leading `-`), accepts optional `--` before TEXT and `--json` before PROJECT or after TEXT, without changing shared `parse`, `a.call` (`run.go:19`) for the wire, `printJSON` for `--json`. Add to `usageText` (`cli.go:40-77`) and the `Run` switch (`cli.go:173-205`).
6. `internal/tui`: add an optional interface `itemNoter { ItemNote(ctx, project, item, text string) error }` next to `laterFiler` (`findings.go:18-22`) with `var _ itemNoter = (*Daemon)(nil)`, and `Daemon.ItemNote` beside `ItemShow` (`daemon.go:99-107`). Do not add it to `Live` (`live.go:21-41`): the test doubles would all need it.
7. `internal/tui/compose.go` (new): `composeState{kind, project, item, input textField, request uint64}` on `Model`, opened by `openNote()` (like `openLaunch`, `launch.go:84`) and closed by `esc`. Add `noteRefusal()` in the shape of `launchRefusal` (`launch.go:67-82`): refuse when the view is not the Roadmap, `m.active < 0` (this covers the Running entry), help is open, the project is unavailable, or `Live` is nil. The Roadmap cursor row gives the item; with `m.itemPane != nil` the pane's item does. `enter` with a blank field keeps it open and says "Note must not be empty". A send returns a command that calls `itemNoter.ItemNote`, then a `noteMsg`; on success set the status `Noted ITEM`, call `m.fetch(project, true)` (`model.go:292-306` shows the pattern) and, if the item pane still shows that item, run `item.show` again as `openItem` does (`roadmap.go:50-75`). Late replies for a closed field only set the status.
8. `internal/tui/model.go:482-540`: route keys to `composeKey` before the `m.launch` branch (`model.go:537`). `internal/tui/projects.go:23-27`: add `m.compose != nil` to `projectTextEntry` so `+` and `-` type into the field.
9. `internal/tui/keys.go`: add `Note key.Binding` (`N`, `shift+n`; help "N" "note on the Roadmap item") to the struct (`keys.go:14-63`), `newKeyMap`, `FullHelp`, and the Roadmap hint cases (`keys.go:344-353`, including the item-pane branch at `keys.go:345-350`) through `offer(!noteRefused, ...)`. Add the field's own hint case (`enter send`, `esc cancel`; pending sends use `esc close`) before the `m.launch` case in `contextHints`. Dispatch `N` in `Model.key` beside `Launch` (`model.go:637`).
10. `internal/tui/roadmap.go:112-141`: after the sections, when `d.Notes` is not empty add `heading("Notes (N)")` and one `- ` bullet per note with a two-space hanging indent on wrapped continuation lines. `Detail` embeds `Item`, so `pane.detail.Notes` is already decoded. Draw the field in the status area the way the launch prompt is drawn.
11. Update `TestRoadmapWritesNothing` (`roadmap_test.go:163-188`): add `N` and a typed line to its key list and keep the zero-write assertion (nothing is written until a non-blank field is sent with `enter`; the test never sends one).
12. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md:1275-1331` (the `N` key, the Notes heading, the field; reword "Editing comes after v1" to say that v1.0 includes filing a slice (S170), notes (S171), and answering or asking adj records (S172, S185); reordering or parking (S67-S69), the matrix editor (S173), and spec drafting (S179) stay later), `docs/design.md:1205-1240` (the `note` command and `item.note`). Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then read the diff in `testdata/golden/`; only the two new `roadmap-note-*` files and the Roadmap item-pane goldens (if any) change.

Order: no dependency on another gap slice. S170 runs after this slice and extends `compose.go` and `item.*` here. S172 and S174 touch `keys.go` and `cli.go` too; merge main before the gate.

Owner decisions 2026-10-30 (interactive, review round 1): the N note hint gets its own drop tier below m matrix, so at 80x24 the Roadmap keeps enter open; l launch; m matrix; tab views and N shows when there is room; ? help lists it.

Review fix round 1 (2026-10-30): CLI blank ITEM exits 2 before dialing; Client.Note refuses blank item. Blank notes say "Note must not be empty". Wrong CLI argument counts say "note: takes PROJECT ITEM TEXT, got N arguments; quote TEXT". N is silent in the matrix pane. Pending esc closes the field without cancelling the write.
